title: 游戏崩溃性bug导致无法继续
description: 频繁出现游戏崩溃性bug，每10分钟就需重启或新建存档，或遇到严重bug导致无法继续游戏。
evidence: Rarely will you even be able to do basic tasks in the starter area without the game breaking catastrophically.
I can't go 10 minutes without a game breaking bug happening forcing me to either reboot the game or having to create a new save entirely.
Now I encountered some serious bug, and have to stop for a while.
